name: pace-method
description: PACE — Personal AI Coach Engine. An open, plan-first AI coaching method for endurance sports, distributed as Claude Code skills (in the spirit of BMAD for software).

plugins.name: pace
plugins.description: Plan-first endurance coaching: guides an athlete from goal discovery (vision) through structured, periodized planning to daily session execution — and never lets the day's mood regenerate the plan. Cycling first; running/triathlon next.
